AcpOptionChoice.description:
A value chosen for one of an ACP agent's config options before its
session exists (client protocol 1.26.0): a draft's model or effort,
applied when the agent's session starts.

PermissionEffect.description:
A value this build does not know reads as `ask`: asking, the effect that
never runs a call unapproved.

PermissionMode.description: A value this build does not know reads as `ask`: asking.

action.description: Permission action a tool declares, such as `read`, `bash`, or a runtime's own action.

resource.description: Current wildcard grammar: '*' matches any characters, '?' matches one character, and the exact '${workspace_dir}' expression is allowed; controls, globstar, escapes, classes, and every other brace form are forbidden. Runtime deserialization additionally enforces a maximum of 4096 UTF-8 bytes; x-cookie-agent-maxUtf8Bytes records that byte limit because JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points.

runtime.description:
Runtime selector (`bash@labpc`): the rule applies only to tools of
runtimes with this runtime ID. Absent, it applies everywhere,
including the base layer.

model.description: One exact base or named-variant model selection.

capability.description:
The capability to attach; the runtime's only capability when
omitted.

workspace.description: Required exactly when the capability takes a workspace.

agent_options.description:
Values for the config options of the session's ACP agent (client
protocol 1.26.0), such as its model and effort, which its new ACP
sessions start with, on top of the agent document's `acp.config`.
The options are the agent's `AgentRuntime.options`; one the agent
does not offer when its session starts is skipped with a
diagnostic. Refused for an agent that is not an ACP agent.

cwd.description:
The client's directory, as the client names it: the workspace of
`local`'s `coding` capability when `runtimes` is omitted. The
session's `cwd_identity` is the canonical workspace its first
attachment with a workspace reports; only a session without one takes
this directory instead, canonicalized on the daemon's machine (as
given when that fails). The daemon's own directory when omitted.

global.description: Whether the session attaches the global runtime; `true` when omitted.

permission_mode.description: The new tree's permission mode; the default mode when omitted.

permission_rules.description:
The session's initial permission overlay, committed with its
creation; empty when omitted.

project.description:
The project the session belongs to (client protocol 1.8.0); an
unknown ID is refused before anything is attached. When `runtimes`
is omitted, the session attaches the project's default `global` and
`runtimes` instead of the usual ones, if it has defaults.

runtimes.description:
The runtimes the session attaches besides `global`, in order. When
omitted, the session attaches `local`'s `coding` capability at `cwd`,
or at the daemon's working directory. Instances that are not running are started first; a
failure creates no session.
